what_it_tests: isotropic S=1/2, one 1H, narrow Lorentzian, Breit-Rabi (exact) positions

opt.Method: exact (garlic default: Breit-Rabi fixed-point solver incl. nuclear Zeeman)

note: Range automatic in EasySpin; stored data.x runs 345.3432..347.7000 (1024 points), use it. garlic (no fast motion) builds the spectrum with Opt.AccumMethod='binning': makespec(...,'round') snaps each line to the NEAREST grid point, then convolves with a sampled lineshape. An analytic-line simulator cannot reproduce the snapping, so the reference itself carries a grid error. Measured: exact Breit-Rabi + analytic Lorentzian derivative differs from the reference by 2.6e-2 of max; the same with nearest-grid snapping reproduces it to 9e-12. resfields_mT are those exact Breit-Rabi positions (CODATA constants, gn(1H) = 5.585694702), a tighter check if labkit exposes line positions.
